choice.basis: The visual evidence from the dashboard confirms that May's energy output is an extreme anomaly, registering at approximately 8,000 kWh. This value is less than half the height of the next lowest month (June, ~17,500 kWh) and falls below the lowest 10,000 kWh tick mark on the chart's y-axis. This represents a severe and isolated drop in output relative to all other displayed months. In the absence of an explicit policy threshold, this magnitude of deviation from the monthly baseline justifies treating the month as a critical low-output anomaly rather than a standard case.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
